baseline_control.test_source_note: The fixed run adds argument-name comments and rustfmt layout. Operations, assertions, timeouts, and the same-pending-future rule are unchanged. Exact baseline test bytes are retained in raw_artifacts.

change_summary.manifest_map: The same 42 path keys map only to sha256 and size; every value was recomputed from actual Git blobs and matched to the clean detached worktree.
change_summary.new_controls: Hold another connection writer reservation, poll one pinned mutation future, verify a complete unchanged ordinary read, release the reservation, await the same future, and verify one transition plus exact idempotent replay.
change_summary.write_transactions: Run and step mutators reserve BEGIN IMMEDIATE before reading history that they will extend. Ordinary read and audit transactions retain deferred snapshots.

claim_limits.native_binding_scope: Rust tests/build/Clippy used the six-file effect patch. Subsequent V5 rebinding changed the workflow and two Python/manifest files. The five Rust/Bazel files remained byte-identical. The source controls and actual V5 verifier validated the final eight-file configuration.
claim_limits.old_ci_interpretation: The old 133/134 run did not log the recovery error variant. The later diagnostic-only b446 run passed 134/134 before this production fix. The deterministic local controls establish their own defect and repair, not a retrospective diagnosis of that CI failure.

github_source_binding.retrieval: Resolve the commit containing this evidence file, fetch each listed path from that same commit, and compare raw SHA256 and byte size. No guessed future commit hash is embedded.

native_fixed_validation.dependency_warnings: Original vendored sqlx-sqlite emitted 40 time API deprecation diagnostics and cached duplicates. Logs retain them; no lint allowance or dependency edit was introduced.

purpose: Retain an ordinary-owner writer-contention regression and bind V5 execution sources to one exact Chain commit.
raw_artifact_decode: Base64-decode data; verify packed_sha256/packed_bytes; gzip-decompress; verify raw_sha256/raw_bytes. Contents retain every original byte, including failures and empty streams.
